# Step - has_key

`has_key` · `hasKey` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps properties whose key is one of the given keys.

## Forms

```text
has_key(arg1: any)
has_key(arg1: array)
has_key(arg1: any, arg2: any)
has_key(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).properties().has_key("age").value().to_list()   // [29]
```
